landing.heroTitle:
The world is accelerating —
Before you start running too,
why not stop and
landing.heroDesc: We built this because we were lost too — watching AI do what we spent years learning, wondering if we'd still matter. Then we realized: the answer was never out there. It was always in here. This tool is a gift we made for ourselves, and now for you.
landing.scrollHint: The answer has always been within
landing.card1Desc: A full career portrait across 5 psychology frameworks. Strengths, blind spots, and growth edges — all yours.
landing.card2Desc: Your report becomes a to-do list. 7 AI tools: resume, cover letter, interview prep, pitch, and more.
landing.card3Desc: A coach that reads your assessment context. Ask anything. Get responses that fit your answers more closely.
landing.card4Desc: Archetype, dimensions, narrative. Come back anytime to track your evolution.
landing.archetypeDesc: Each archetype maps two interest dimensions to a career identity — with its own strengths, growth edges, and career directions. You'll see which roles naturally fit, which ones drain you, and why your past choices make more sense than you thought.
landing.abyssTitle:
What you share here
never leaves the deep.
landing.abyssDesc: Real self-exploration requires real privacy. Your doubts, ambitions, and contradictions — protected here, and always yours to export or delete. That's the point.
landing.bottomTitle:
Your inner voice has been waiting
for you to slow down and listen.
landing.footerTagline: Human-Centric AI — look inward, understand your distinct strengths
landing.mockArchetypeTagline: Seeing what others miss and mending what matters
landing.mockNarrative: "You create meaning by connecting what others overlook. Your strength isn't choosing one path — it's seeing how they all connect."
landing.footerMotto: Dive deep. Hear your own voice.
landing.breathQuote:
The right career was never something to find.
You just need to see yourself.
landing.clarityStep1Desc: 38 career interest and values questions, about 5 minutes. Map your RIASEC profile, discover your value orientation, and see which directions energize you most.
landing.clarityStep2Desc: 86 scenario-based questions across personality, values, and cognitive style. Not checkboxes — real dilemmas that reveal what your résumé never shows.
landing.clarityStep3Desc: Your psychological profile — revealed instantly. Career archetype, personality dimensions, cognitive style, shadow side. A mirror for how you tend to show up, beyond what your résumé says.
landing.clarityStep4Desc: AI-generated career report: career anchors, top matches, growth paths, and blind spots. Not generic advice — a map drawn from your unique pattern.
landing.clarityStep5Desc: Turn insight into action. AI-powered tools for resumes, interviews, and pitches — plus a coach that reads your full profile context. Ask anything, get responses that fit your answers more closely.
landing.clarityTime: Quick Dive: ~5 min · Deep Dive: ~20 min
landing.narrativeExploreCardDesc: 15-20 min · 30 camp scenarios + 8 values prompts · story-driven discovery
landing.deepDiveCardDesc: ~20 min · 86 questions across 3 modules · Full career report + AI coaching
landing.resonanceTitle:
Look up at the stars. Feel the ground beneath your feet.
Your path lives somewhere between the dream and the real.
landing.resonanceDesc: Deep Dive was built for people navigating between worlds — between cultures, between careers, between who they are and who they're becoming.
landing.forWhoTitle:
Built for those navigating
uncharted waters
landing.forWhoSubtitle: Whether you're crossing borders, changing paths, or outrunning a wave of change — Deep Dive meets you where you are.
landing.forWho1Desc: Your cross-cultural identity isn't a gap. It's your edge. We help you see that.
landing.forWho2Title: People Finding Themselves in the AI Wave
landing.forWho2Desc: When AI does what you studied for years — the question is not only what to do next, but what you care about enough to keep shaping.
landing.forWho3Desc: That thread connecting all your past roles? We help you find where it leads.
landing.forWho4Desc: Cut through infinite options with a profile built on how you actually think.
landing.socialProofTitle:
Built on real science.
Felt like real conversation.
landing.trustFrameworks: Built on O*NET Interest Profiler · IPIP · Schwartz Values · Big Five
landing.credPillar1: Grounded in validated instruments used in career research worldwide — not personality quizzes from a blog post.
landing.credPillar2: We don't share your data. You can export it or request deletion anytime.
landing.credPillar3: Developed as part of academic research at the University of Amsterdam — thesis-grade rigor, product-grade experience.
